notes: 119-HRES-878. H. Res. 878 is a one-page House simple resolution (Engrossed in House, EH) disapproving the behavior of Rep. Chuy Garcia of Illinois over Illinois primary ballot filing. Every factual bill-content claim (summary, brief, top_lines, section label/main/detail, changes, gaps) traces verbatim to the five Whereas clauses and the single resolving clause: dates (Oct 27 / Nov 5 / Nov 6, 2025), the March 2026 Democratic primary, chief of staff Patty Garcia, the 'at his direction' finding, 'undermining a free and fair election', and 'beneath the dignity of his office' all check out with no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity issue. ONE MATERIAL OMISSION: Whereas 5 finds the conduct 'beneath the dignity of his office AND incompatible with the spirit of the United States Constitution'; the analysis conveys only the first conjunct and omits the constitutional-incompatibility characterization entirely across all fields. Two minor items: (a) the summary adds the given name 'Jesus' (present in the official-title metadata but not the engrossed text); (b) likelihoodReason cites 'Roll no. 292', which is neither in the bill text nor in the votes[] structured data (no roll-number field) and is unverifiable from the provided sources. likelihoodReason vote/stage facts (adopted 236-183, 4 present, Nov 18 2025, House-only simple resolution, D-WA sponsor of Garcia's own party, 0 cosponsors) were verified against votes[]/sponsor/cosponsor metadata per rubric step-4 (empty sourceSpan on metadata-only rows) — all consistent, no stage/vote drift (stage=house, stageLabel 'Passed House', votes[0] Passed). featured_quotes[] are Congressional Record floor quotes (Espaillat, Morelle, Garcia) not present in the fetched engrossed source and are out of scope for this bill-text audit. sourceReadDepth full (entire 1210-char source read).
